summary.intent: Close the race in grpc-go#7365 where two concurrent addrConn.connect() calls both observed Idle and both started tryAllAddrs, orphaning a transport, by keeping ac.mu held from the Idle check through the move to Connecting (resetTransport becomes resetTransportAndUnlock). Intent sources: the supplied PR text, issue 7365, and four real commit messages.
summary.issue_fit: Met: the Idle check and the Connecting transition now share one critical section in connect() and updateAddrs(); no path found that starts a second attempt or double-unlocks.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff (clientconn.go) reviewed with callers, onClose/GracefulClose, and the callback serializer. Reviewer-executed at head: root package Test/UpdateAddresses_NoopIfCalledWithSameAddresses and Test/ResetConnectBackoff, and xdsclient Test/AuthorityRevive, all with -race, all pass. No test was added or changed; the 0.4% flake cannot be reproduced deterministically in the allowance, so the fix rests on the trace and the verifier's three premise rulings, not on the passing runs.

requirements.source: pr-body/"no concurrent requests are able to start once caller of `resetTransport` does some validation and calls `resetTransport`"
requirements.evidence: clientconn.go:918-922 connect() keeps ac.mu from the Idle check to resetTransportAndUnlock, which sets Connecting at :1261 before Unlock at :1262; updateAddrs hands the held lock to the goroutine at :996.
The window between connect()'s Unlock and resetTransport's Lock is gone; a second connect() sees state Connecting and returns (clientconn.go:912-919).

requirements.source: pr-body/"Verified that Test/AuthorityRevive no longer flakes for 100000 attempts"
requirements.evidence: A 100000-run measurement was not repeated; Test/AuthorityRevive passed once with -race at the head.
clientconn.go:1231-1233 carries the doc comment stating the lock contract.

tasks.premise: Every caller of resetTransportAndUnlock holds ac.mu and every return path releases it exactly once; at most one attempt starts per Idle-to-Connecting transition.
Handing the locked ac.mu to the goroutine in updateAddrs cannot deadlock with the deferred GracefulClose/onClose, which only waits for the goroutine's Unlock.
Keeping ac.mu held across the updateAddrs restart allows no duplicate or stale attempt and no path other than resetTransportAndUnlock moves Idle into an attempt.
